title: Final Choice Comparison Matrix
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare two to four finalist colleges with a weighted decision matrix of cost, fit, outcomes, distance, and gut sense, and see which factors drive the result.

learningObjectives: Students will weigh their finalist colleges on cost, academic fit, social fit, outcomes, and personal sense using weights that reflect their own priorities, and justify a final choice by identifying the factors that most influence it.

controls: Add factor, Add college, and Remove college buttons

keyQuestions: Why isn't the highest total automatically the right choice?
What does it mean when your gut disagrees with the total?
Which factor would you never trade away?
commonMisconceptions: A spreadsheet can make the decision for you.
Rankings should carry the most weight.
assessmentOpportunities: Students build a matrix for their finalists and justify their choice by naming the factors that drive the result.
